## Acceptance criteria

- REQ-01 met: [guarantees.md:179](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/guarantees.md:179) distinguishes git-free issue assignment from advisory leases and documents typed exit-10 failures for missing repositories and unresolved `HEAD`.
- REQ-02 met: [guarantees.md:190](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/guarantees.md:190) lists every advisory-lease command as requiring git.
- REQ-03 met: the example demonstrates git-free assignment, both lease failure modes, successful acquisition after an initial commit, and valid document history.

Documentation-only changes. No domain, storage, command, CLI, or output boundary violations were introduced.

The documented `ClaimRequiresGitError` and exit code 10 match the implementation. No error-handling code changed.

## Documentation

The latest prior finding is resolved at [guarantees.md:234](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/guarantees.md:234): the example creates `path/to` and the initial document before `jit doc add`. It also configures a repository-local Git identity before committing.

No public APIs were added or changed.

## Prior review feedback and dependencies

Both previous findings are resolved:

- The lease example creates an initial commit before acquisition.
- The document-history example creates its parent directory and initial file.

The issue declares no dependencies or unmet dependencies.
